caption:
A right hand holds a reflective optical disc by its edges against a dark wooden tabletop, with a green Staples CD-RW jewel case resting in the lower-left corner. The disc's shiny face displays radial rainbow diffraction bands and a printed inner hub. Throughout the clip, the hand, disc center, and background remain in essentially fixed positions, while the rainbow color bands shift their angular positions around the disc, sweeping around the center rather than translating across the surface.

Bright specular reflection spots change on the right half of the disc. These highlights are absent or faint in the early frames, then a single bright blob appears near the right edge. In the later frames, two distinct round white highlights are visible on the right side, indicating a subtle change in the disc's tilt relative to the light source.

The inner hub text keeps roughly the same radial orientation across the excerpt, indicating the disc is not spinning about its own center. The background wood grain and the case stay in place, consistent with the camera being stationary.
